verdicts.reason: Both are nearly identical and broken. The reading order is scrambled: 'THE MINIMALIST' sits above the name and 'DDG STUDIO PRESENTS' below it. The pink dots run into the D and N of DEAN. The white text panel cuts across the top of the geometric graphic, and the 'OPENING…' line is jammed against the left edge and the white frame. The frame is left hanging over an empty white area, so the bottom of the canvas is dead space. A leaves a much larger empty area at the bottom (about 30% of the height), with all the text crammed at the top. B is centred a little better vertically, but its panel covers more of the graphic, so it is only marginally less lopsided.
